textNodes.text: Sole Supply had a sneaker drop in six weeks and a website that still looked like a reseller's catalogue. They needed a launch that felt like a brand, not a sale.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: We built one campaign page, one product template and a checkout that never leaves the story, then tested every step with real buyers before the drop.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Ran a two-day kick-off with the Sole Supply team to agree the one thing launch week had to prove
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Art-directed a two-day shoot around a single red sneaker and a yellow wall
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Designed the campaign page and product template in Figma as one system
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Built the front end in React with the in-house developer, reviewed every Friday
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Stayed on for launch week to watch the numbers and fix what slowed people down
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Same hands on both sides. The frame on the left is the design file, the panel on the right is what shipped — type, spacing and colour come straight across.
